## **Invoice 2 (Q4 of Edgeware R&D)**

**﻿Version 1.1.1**

Separated the two invoices in the document leaving just invoice 2 detail
Created a separate post to ensure easier organisation and discovery

**Version 1.1**

Corrected USD/GBP monthly exchange rate ([used this tool](https://www.x-rates.com/average/?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=1&year=2022))
Added missing NSF on Invoice 2
Added calculation for FX movement and risk with post-paid model 

**Version 1.0**

This invoice covers the first current period of work on Edgeware R&D and is aimed to be the last that is solely funded by Edgeware.

**Highlights and ongoing R&D**

Work underway with establishing initial context and rationale for Network Publics.

(Re) Introducing Edgeware to the Kusama community with the aim of establishing rationale for the  introduction of Network Publics as a third category of parachain.

- [Hello Kusama, this is Edgeware](https://kusama.polkassembly.io/post/1698)


Aim of unlocking Kusama treasury for Edgeware contributor funding within chain incubator model, to alleviate pressure on Edgeware R&D financing.

Developing more cohesive strategy around Edgeware, Kabocha's and Kusama's value accrual mechanisms. 

Curating technical projects focused on tackling Edgeware's governance challenges. 

Curating technical projects that evolve Edgeware's publishing operations. 

Curating technical projects that further validate Edgeware's chain incubator model. 

Research on make up of Edgeware membership and interests

- [Why are you here? ](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6300-why-are-you-here-an-occasional-edgeware-question)


**Funding detail**

Other information as detailed in initial post. 

On chain proposals and simple majority referendum to follow.
